title: ANCHOR
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain.

session.prompt: Hope is called an anchor — what in you steadies when you fix it to God's promise?
A baseline for the month: where is your hope right now, and where are you most grateful today? Write it honestly so you can look back at the end of the month.
Focus on what you're thankful God has already done.

coaching_notes: What you put your hope in matters. This month, allow God to reveal sources of hope that don't serve you.
